name: Wonderscape Sage
oracle_text:
Flying
{T}, Return a land you control to its owner's hand: Draw a card. Then discard a card unless that land had a nonbasic land type.
blocked_sentences: {T}, Return a land you control to its owner's hand: Draw a card. Then discard a card unless that land had a nonbasic land type.

needs.what: a selector/condition clause 'has a nonbasic land type' (any land subtype other than Plains, Island, Swamp, Mountain, Forest -- CR 205.3i), evaluated against the last-known information of the land the return_to_hand cost bounced (its `as` snapshot), so `if` can read 'unless that land had a nonbasic land type'
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The return_to_hand cost can bind the land with `as` (returned_snapshot), and `{binding: ...}` selectors can be narrowed by `subtypes`/`not_subtypes`, but those match the object's current characteristics in its new zone rather than what it had on the battlefield, and there is no 'nonbasic land type' predicate: `not_subtypes` of the five basics is a different question (a Wastes-like land with no type passes), and enumerating Gate/Desert/Locus/... in `subtypes` is a hand-maintained approximation. values.BASIC_LAND_TYPES exists but only domain reads it.
